messages:
Jasper Lee: hey team :wave: i'm jasper, joined today as a platform engineer (he/him). i'm in phx and will be hybrid. hobbies: amateur astrophotography and shamelessly competitive board games. excited to meet folks!
Maya Chen: welcome jasper!! :tada: astrophotography?! pls share photos. also we have a board game shelf in the lounge  bring something for game night.
Ivy Bryce: hi jasper, welcome :heart: quick question: coffee order? we have a coffee sign-up board for morning rounds.
Jasper Lee: @Ivy medium americano with oat milk, less foam. i'll sign up for thursday morning.
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Jasper! Reminder: badge pickup, equipment form, benefits intro. Links: <https://intranet/onboard|onboarding checklist>. Reply "help" to get assistance.
SnackBot: Pro tip: label any shared snacks and put allergy notes. 
Maya Chen: tiny poll: who wants to join a rooftop star photo walk this weekend? :stars:
Ivy Bryce: count me in  i've got a cheap tripod to lend.
Jasper Lee: i'd love that. also for game night i'll bring a light 60-90 min eurogame.
Maya Chen: perfect. we'll DM details. welcome aboard and can't wait to see star pics and game picks :grin:
Jasper Lee: thanks everyone! quick logistics Q: where's the bike rack?
Ivy Bryce: bike rack by the east entrance, next to the scooter zone. facilities prefers you register your bike on the intranet.
Jasper Lee: got it, thanks. see you all soon :coffee:
